question: Is the effective edge spatial-frequency response of the same recorded Epson 10000XL and TG13 workflow stable across the two independently confirmed P6K tone-response regimes, or must spatial response also remain a time-regime scanner nuisance?

current_standard.name: ISO 12233:2024 Digital cameras - Resolution and spatial frequency responses
current_standard.use: Terminology and e-SFR measurement principle only; this experiment does not claim ISO conformance.

current_film_scanner_evidence.name: Plutino et al. 2025 Tonal distribution and glare assessment in cinematographic film scanners
current_film_scanner_evidence.use: Independent evidence that scanner and laboratory processing are nuisance variables; its P6Z table is not reused for fitting here.

source.rights: APPLAUSE DR4 CC0-1.0; reuse exact local P6K files only, with no new download.

measurement.edge_selection_information_flow: Use only the eight development scans. Freeze the intersection of edges meeting the contrast and line-support gates before opening any confirmation image.

branch_rule.regime_nuisance_pass: Retain two effective scanner/wedge spatial-response regimes as nuisance controls. Do not compile one shared scanner MTF.
branch_rule.shared_stability_pass: Open one separately frozen same-device effective-SFR compiler, still bound to this scanner, wedge type and workflow.
branch_rule.otherwise: Close before compiler work and continue a distinct physical image-formation leaf.

forbidden: treat the TG13 transition as an ideal optical edge or an absolute scanner PSF/MTF truth
infer exact physical wedge identity, film stock, emulsion, exposure, development or scanner calibration
select edges, thresholds, smoothing, roles or branch after confirmation scoring
reuse the P6Z context-glare table as fit data
visual or product promotion from this experiment
claim_ceiling: Same-workflow effective TG13 edge-SFR stability or time-regime nuisance evidence for one recorded Epson 10000XL stream; not absolute scanner MTF, film MTF, stock/process response, calibration or product evidence.
